spec.description: Clusters of Single Board Computers
5 minute load average per node.
spec.title: Load average

spec.expr: max by (nodename) (node_thermal_zone_temp{sbc="true", type=~"bigcore0.*"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Big core thermal zone temperature per node (node_thermal_zone_temp).
spec.title: Temperatures

spec.description: Per-container CPU usage from cAdvisor (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total).
spec.title: Container CPU Usage

spec.description: Running containers per node from cAdvisor (container_last_seen), grouped by the host label.
spec.title: Number of container on Cluster

spec.description: Uptime per Swarm service from cAdvisor (container_start_time_seconds).
spec.title: Uptime of Containers on Cluster

spec.expr: sum by (nodename) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint="/mnt/storage"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint="/mnt/storage"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})
sum by (nodename) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint="/mnt/storage"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Bulk storage on /mnt/storage: used and total bytes per node.
spec.title: Bulk Storage

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (nodename) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint="/mnt/nvme"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint="/mnt/nvme"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / sum by (nodename) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint="/mnt/nvme"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: NVMe volume mounted at /mnt/nvme: used percentage per node.
spec.title: NVME Usage

spec.description: Free RAM per node (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes). Thresholds are 6, 12 and 15 GiB.
spec.title: Ram Free on Each node

spec.description: Node boot uptime (node_boot_time_seconds), one value per host.
spec.title: Uptime

spec.expr: sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{sbc="true", device="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})
sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{sbc="true", device="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Wired traffic on eth0. In = received, Out = transmitted.
spec.title: Network Traffic Wired

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (nodename, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/docker/.*", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/docker/.*", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / sum by (nodename, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{sbc="true", mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/docker/.*", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Percentage used per mountpoint (excludes tmpfs/overlay/docker internals).
spec.title: Filesystem Usage

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (nodename, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_files{sbc="true", mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/docker/.*", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs"} - node_filesystem_files_free{sbc="true", mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/docker/.*", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / sum by (nodename, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_files{sbc="true", mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/docker/.*", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Percentage of inodes used per mountpoint.
spec.title: Inode Usage

spec.description: Bytes read and written per second, summed over physical disks.
spec.title: Disk Throughput

spec.description: Completed read/write operations per second, summed over physical disks.
spec.title: Disk IOPS

spec.description: Share of time the disks were busy (summed across disks, so may exceed 100%).
spec.title: Disk Utilization

spec.expr: sum by (nodename) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{sbc="true", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / sum by (nodename) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{sbc="true", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

sum by (nodename) (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{sbc="true", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / sum by (nodename) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{sbc="true", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Average time per completed I/O operation.
spec.title: Disk Latency

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{sbc="true", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}))

spec.description: Non-idle CPU time per node.
spec.title: CPU Usage

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - sum by (nodename) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{sbc="true"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / sum by (nodename) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{sbc="true"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}))

spec.description: Used memory as a percentage of total RAM.
spec.title: Memory Usage

spec.description: Filesystems currently mounted read-only or reporting device errors. Both should be 0.
spec.title: Filesystem Health

spec.expr: 100 * (node_nf_conntrack_entries{sbc="true"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"}) / (node_nf_conntrack_entries_limit{sbc="true"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Connection tracking table usage per node.
spec.title: Conntrack Usage

spec.expr: sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{sbc="true", device="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})
sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{sbc="true", device="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})
sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{sbc="true", device="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{sbc="true"})

spec.description: Error and drop rate on eth0 per node.
